note: minimal binary operator: FUNCTION + LEFTARG + RIGHTARG
unary prefix operator: FUNCTION + RIGHTARG only (no LEFTARG)
binary operator with COMMUTATOR clause (mutual commutators)
binary operator with NEGATOR clause (mutual negators)

sql:
CREATE FUNCTION oprb0005_fn(integer, integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT $1 < $2 $$;
CREATE OPERATOR @<^ (FUNCTION = oprb0005_fn, LEFTARG = integer, RIGHTARG = integer, RESTRICT = scalarltsel, JOIN = scalarltjoinsel)
note: binary operator with RESTRICT and JOIN selectivity functions

CREATE FUNCTION oprb0006_fn(integer, integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT $1 = $2 $$;
CREATE OPERATOR @=^ (FUNCTION = oprb0006_fn, LEFTARG = integer, RIGHTARG = integer, HASHES, MERGES)
note: binary operator with HASHES and MERGES flags

sql:
CREATE FUNCTION oprb0007_fn(integer, integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT $1 < $2 $$;
CREATE OPERATOR s.@<^ (FUNCTION = oprb0007_fn, LEFTARG = integer, RIGHTARG = integer, RESTRICT = scalarltsel, JOIN = scalarltjoinsel, COMMUTATOR = OPERATOR(s.@>^), NEGATOR = OPERATOR(s.@>=^))
note: schema-qualified operator name; COMMUTATOR and NEGATOR use OPERATOR(schema.op) form
